name: Sinbad's abandoned road shop
source:
"Start a blog they said."

    "Become rich they said."

    "See the world they said."

    You arn't yet rich and you haven't traveled the world. yet. But you do have a blog

    about haunted places called 'Ghostogram'.

    And your readers always demand new content.

    So here you are, out on the road again since it's time for yet another haunted location:

    Sinbad's abandoned road shop.

    In the distance, down the road, You see what must be the place as it grows larger as you approach it...

[From [url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/sinbads-abandoned-road-shop]Itch.io[/url]]
